nodes.label: Mastery estimator heuristic-v1 (weight formula, confidence from weight)
nodes.norm_label: mastery estimator heuristic-v1 (weight formula, confidence from weight)

nodes.norm_label: four mastery dimensions (recognition, recall, application, transfer)

nodes.norm_label: learning evidence (one row per skill per real grade)

nodes.label: XP append-only ledger with corrections
nodes.rationale: Mastery and XP are independent: XP rewards effort, mastery estimates what evidence supports

nodes.label: FSRS-6 spaced repetition scheduler (py-fsrs port)
nodes.rationale: No fuzzing so schedules are deterministic; only short recall questions scheduled

nodes.label: Developer aids (CRAMLAB_* env vars, snapshot, self-test)
nodes.norm_label: developer aids (cramlab_* env vars, snapshot, self-test)

nodes.label: ADR-001 CramLabCore (no UI) plus thin CramLabApp shell
nodes.norm_label: adr-001 cramlabcore (no ui) plus thin cramlabapp shell
nodes.rationale: Keeps logic testable without UI and enforces views not computing progression

nodes.label: ADR-002 GRDB records are the domain models
nodes.norm_label: adr-002 grdb records are the domain models
nodes.rationale: A separate DTO layer would double code for no current benefit

nodes.label: ADR-003 UUID blob primary keys, camelCase columns
nodes.norm_label: adr-003 uuid blob primary keys, camelcase columns
nodes.rationale: Stable identifiers for sync/backup

nodes.label: ADR-004 Skills global rows via course_skills; auto-reuse only within a course
nodes.norm_label: adr-004 skills global rows via course_skills; auto-reuse only within a course
nodes.rationale: Cross-course equivalence is explicit related relation, never automatic

nodes.label: ADR-005 Cumulative assessments are a flag; scope computed
nodes.norm_label: adr-005 cumulative assessments are a flag; scope computed
nodes.rationale: Later-added skills are covered without edits

nodes.label: ADR-006 Hierarchy and prerequisites are separate relations with cycle checks
nodes.norm_label: adr-006 hierarchy and prerequisites are separate relations with cycle checks

nodes.label: ADR-007 Archive instead of delete for skills/courses
nodes.norm_label: adr-007 archive instead of delete for skills/courses
nodes.rationale: Future evidence, XP and attempts keep valid references

nodes.label: ADR-008 Documents deduplicated by (course, SHA-256); originals preserved
nodes.norm_label: adr-008 documents deduplicated by (course, sha-256); originals preserved
nodes.rationale: Failed extraction flagged, never silently replaced by OCR

nodes.label: ADR-009 Direct-swiftc build script
nodes.rationale: SwiftPM/Xcode unusable on the dev machine; Package.swift kept for Xcode users

nodes.label: ADR-010 ObservableObject instead of @Observable
nodes.rationale: Avoids macro-plugin dependence on a limited toolchain

nodes.label: ADR-011 Question content as JSON payload on immutable revisions
nodes.norm_label: adr-011 question content as json payload on immutable revisions
nodes.rationale: Revision immutability enforced by SQLite trigger, not convention

nodes.label: ADR-012 Readiness is not validity; verified needs independent check
nodes.norm_label: adr-012 readiness is not validity; verified needs independent check
nodes.rationale: Valid JSON never implies a correct answer

nodes.label: ADR-013 Responses matched by requestId, deduped by canonical-JSON hash
nodes.norm_label: adr-013 responses matched by requestid, deduped by canonical-json hash
nodes.rationale: Prevents mis-attachment; re-pasting is a no-op; audit trail kept

nodes.label: ADR-014 Skill resolution on import: exact/near/none
nodes.norm_label: adr-014 skill resolution on import: exact/near/none
nodes.rationale: Near match left untagged and flagged for review

nodes.label: ADR-015 Code editor on AppKit NSTextView, no third-party package
nodes.norm_label: adr-015 code editor on appkit nstextview, no third-party package
nodes.rationale: SwiftPM unusable so editor libraries cannot be resolved; revisit CodeEditSourceEditor with real Xcode

nodes.label: ADR-016 Native LaTeX-subset renderer instead of web view
nodes.norm_label: adr-016 native latex-subset renderer instead of web view
nodes.rationale: Avoids WKWebView and bundled JS; offline, inert, testable; unsupported shows source

nodes.label: ADR-017 Attempts one per session item with pinned revision
nodes.norm_label: adr-017 attempts one per session item with pinned revision
nodes.rationale: Clean append-only history; no attempt can point at changed content

nodes.label: ADR-018 Practice records submissions only (no verdict before M5)
nodes.norm_label: adr-018 practice records submissions only (no verdict before m5)
nodes.rationale: Nothing graded by implication

nodes.label: ADR-019 Grades append-only; current via partial unique index
nodes.norm_label: adr-019 grades append-only; current via partial unique index
nodes.rationale: Evidence, XP corrections and snapshots follow in one transaction so they cannot disagree

nodes.label: ADR-020 XP reconciled to desired net amount
nodes.norm_label: adr-020 xp reconciled to desired net amount
nodes.rationale: Makes retries idempotent and regrades auditable

nodes.label: ADR-021 Grade trust gates rewards, not participation
nodes.norm_label: adr-021 grade trust gates rewards, not participation
nodes.rationale: Unverified AI key cannot hand out rewards; verifying unlocks them

nodes.label: ADR-022 Mastery is live computation; snapshots are history
nodes.norm_label: adr-022 mastery is live computation; snapshots are history
nodes.rationale: Recency decay would make stored value stale

nodes.label: ADR-023 FSRS ported not reinvented; verification stated honestly
nodes.norm_label: adr-023 fsrs ported not reinvented; verification stated honestly
nodes.rationale: Docs say ported and cross-checked until compared against real library

nodes.label: ADR-024 Planner is a pure function of local evidence
nodes.norm_label: adr-024 planner is a pure function of local evidence
nodes.rationale: Same data gives same plan; every item carries a reason; no AI/network/randomness

nodes.label: ADR-025 Exam scope is authoritative
nodes.rationale: Out-of-scope prerequisites surfaced as notes; AI-estimated importance down-weighted

nodes.label: ADR-026 Coaching advisory and rate-limited
nodes.rationale: No authority over the question list

nodes.label: ADR-027 Focus time is a record, not evidence
nodes.norm_label: adr-027 focus time is a record, not evidence
nodes.rationale: Sleep counts as paused, background as active; open intervals closed as interrupted

nodes.label: ADR-028 Backups are folders, not archives
nodes.norm_label: adr-028 backups are folders, not archives
nodes.rationale: Avoids zip extractor path-traversal class; easy to inspect

nodes.label: ADR-029 Draw our own meters
nodes.rationale: AppKit ProgressView ignored tints in light mode

nodes.label: ADR-030 Guard bindings handed to scenes
nodes.norm_label: adr-030 guard bindings handed to scenes
nodes.rationale: Scene APIs may write bindings every update; only forward real changes

nodes.label: ADR-031 Aggregate queries over per-row queries
nodes.norm_label: adr-031 aggregate queries over per-row queries
nodes.rationale: Scale test showed per-row lookups dominating; heavy loads off main thread

nodes.label: ADR-032 Seatbelt sandbox with launcher and supervisor
nodes.norm_label: adr-032 seatbelt sandbox with launcher and supervisor
nodes.rationale: Docker/VMs unavailable; sandbox-exec deny-by-default is strongest isolation without entitlements; deprecated and memory polled

nodes.label: ADR-033 Code-test key trusted only after reference passes
nodes.norm_label: adr-033 code-test key trusted only after reference passes
nodes.rationale: Runner problems leave the answer pending, never wrong

nodes.label: ADR-034 Symbolic equivalence exact, narrow and honest
nodes.norm_label: adr-034 symbolic equivalence exact, narrow and honest
nodes.rationale: Avoids numeric-sampling false positives; unsupported routed to learner

nodes.label: ADR-035 Calibration informs, never changes
nodes.rationale: Needs >=30 predictions and clear margin; constants change only via versioned code change

nodes.label: ADR-036 Direct AI is the manual bridge with a different transport
nodes.norm_label: adr-036 direct ai is the manual bridge with a different transport
nodes.rationale: Same prepared request and import pipeline; HTTPTransport seam keeps it testable offline
